data.title: 天雨亚子 · 迎宾露台的大胆露背晚礼服
data.description: 政务宴会退场后的夜风露台，月光如银倾泻在雕花石栏上。亚子身穿一袭惊艳的深黑丝绒露背晚礼服，白皙无瑕的整个美背在夜色中完全舒展。晚风拂起她灰色的卷发马尾，她单手扶着栏杆回眸望来，湛蓝眼眸在夜色中显得深沉而勾人心魄，展现出独当一面的高官冷艳与隐藏的炽热。
data.action: standing at marble balcony railing showing bare back in backless velvet gown, turning head to gaze at viewer, wind fluttering grey twintails, dignified alluring expression
data.location: grand classical palace balcony under full moon
data.lighting: dramatic moonlit backlighting contrasting with warm stone sconces
data.mood: regal commanding sensuality, elegant nocturnal beauty
data.promptProse: Standing on a marble terrace under the full moon, Amau Ako wears a breathtaking black backless evening gown. Her back and shoulders are illuminated in silver moonlight as she glances over her shoulder with poise.
data.animaCaption: Ako on a palace balcony wearing a backless black velvet gown, looking over her shoulder.
